image_generation_request.instructions: Generate a high-quality product poster. Use the file 'style_reference.jpeg' as the strict visual style guide (colors, lighting, composition). Use the file 'subject_reference_X.jpeg' (where X is 1, 2, or 3) as the definitive subject to be featured.

subject_definition.action: Stationary, presented as a hero object
subject_definition.position: Centered in the lower two-thirds of the frame

composition.negative_space: Ample negative space at the top
composition.background: Solid color or subtle gradient consistent with style_reference

text_integration.font_style: Match the typographic feel of the style_reference if visible, otherwise Bold Sans-serif
